newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rides IBM rollercoaster, ends slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rides IBM rollercoaster, ends slightly lower.

text.p: Technology stocks took a ride on the IBM railroad Monday, with the Nasdaq Composite Index closing slightly lower, off six or about 1/2 percent to an unofficial close of 1236.

The Nasdaq Composite Index, heavily weighted with technology, peaked at about 1100 EDT, roughly the same time as IBM's peak, after the company's chief financial officer forecast a strong outlook for the year.
Roughly 465 million shares changing hands, with decliners leading advancers by about a three to two ratio.

"When IBM took off, everyone got excited. When it stopped slipping, the market stopped falling," said Nelson Gold, senior vice president of OTC trading at Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp, who expressed some pessimism about the long-term future of the bull market.

Molten Metal shares tumbled 13-7/8 to 14-1/4, shearing off nearly half the company's market capitalization from roughly $780 million to $400 million after the company said it lost a $12 million contract and would delay its entry into the fly ash market for a year.
Microsoft Corp Q1 share earnings rose to $0.95..
